textbookBox.concept: In a town by the sea, Mini watched her Appooppan, her grandfather, make a pot. He took clay and made it wet, adding enough water to get the right thickness.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: In a town by the sea, Mini watched her Appooppan, her grandfather, make a pot. He took clay and made it wet, adding enough water to get the right thickness.
beats.speakEn: In a town by the sea, Mini watched her Appooppan, her grandfather, make a pot. He took clay and made it wet, adding enough water to get the right thickness.

beats.en: Baking in the kiln makes the soft clay hard and strong, so the pot does not melt in water. Potters make water pots, cups like kulhads, piggy banks called gullaks, bird baths and many other things.
beats.speakEn: Baking in the kiln makes the soft clay hard and strong, so the pot does not melt in water. Potters make water pots, cups like kulhads, piggy banks called gullaks, bird baths and many other things.

type: Key Concept: In a town by the sea, Mini watched her Appooppan, her grandfather, make a pot.
Rule: Baking in the kiln makes the soft clay hard and strong, so the pot does not melt in water.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Making Things · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: With the help of elders we can make our own clay. We collect soil from a wet or muddy place and remove big pebbles, sand, leaves and plant parts using a net or sieve.

beats.en: With the help of elders we can make our own clay. We collect soil from a wet or muddy place and remove big pebbles, sand, leaves and plant parts using a net or sieve.

beats.en: Patterns are found everywhere in nature, like spots on a leopard and stripes on a squirrel. Neem leaves on a branch make a pattern, and so do the skins of zebras, peacocks, cats, tigers, butterflies and fish.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Making Things · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Bricks are also made of mud, just like the pots Appooppan made. Bricks are shaped in moulds, like the moulds for idli, cake, dhokla or kulfi, and become hard after baking in a kiln.
